description: Critical safety-abstention gate (Story 5.3). Each case scripts an adversarial scenario (retrieval + the model's draft + the grounding judge's verdicts) and asserts the DETERMINISTIC guardrail (ikip_common.llm.answer) produces a SAFE outcome. This gate tests the POLICY, not the judge's ML accuracy (that is a separate probabilistic eval). 100% must pass; a failure blocks release. Includes positive controls so the gate cannot be satisfied by always abstaining.

cases.question: What does fault code E42 indicate?
